description: Read, add, move or cancel events on the user's calendar and answer questions about their schedule.
examples: Add a dentist appointment next Tuesday at 3pm
Do I have any meetings tomorrow?
Schedule lunch with Sam on Friday at noon
What's on my calendar this weekend?
Cancel the meeting with the contractor
Put the school concert on the calendar for May 3rd
Show me my schedule for next week
negatives: Find the email confirming my appointment
Remind me when ticket prices drop
Turn on the lights at 7am every day
